company.description:
Bluma is a technology platform that allows beauty-conscious contemporary women to save time by having their on-demand beauty needs fulfilled by a lifestyle brand in the comfort of their home.

Independent service providers, qualified by Bluma and operating under the Bluma brand deliver the services following Bluma Standard Guidelines.

Bluma is headquartered in Medellín, Colombia
